title: House build (3D)
description: A simple modern two-storey house assembles (slab, walls rise, windows, roofs land), the camera orbits, and room labels with areas count up on points in the house.

title.description: Headline; wrap one word in {braces} for the italic serif accent.

subline.description: Line at the bottom. Simple HTML allowed (<b> = accent).

rooms.description: Room labels {name, area, at}. at = [x, y, z] in metres in the model: x -4..4 (left-right), z -2.5..2.5 (back-front), ground floor y ≈ 1.4, upper floor y ≈ 4.6, roof terrace y ≈ 3.5 at x < -1.3.

unit.description: Area unit shown after each number (m², sq ft).

wallColor.description: Render colour of the ground-floor walls.

woodColor.description: Cladding colour of the upper volume.

labelStart.description: Second the first room label appears (the others follow every 0.22 s).

theme.description: Backdrop variant from base.css (the site plate follows it).

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: areas match the real plan (or the scene says it is an example)
labels stay on screen through the orbit
